value.rationale: The Pappus graph is the canonical Levi graph of a classical (9_3) configuration and is 216-symmetric. Computing its full equivariant topology distinguishes two fixed rational homology dimensions under an order-three subgroup versus zero under the whole group; the character norm exactly identifies two inequivalent complex irreducible constituents, and an integral acyclic matching gives a homotopy type rather than a rank-only numerical table. This is a natural invariant and substantive symmetry refinement.
